prompt_head:
You are checking the piece ends of a Thai TV talk-show cut (โหนกระแส, long-form YouTube edit).
Each line is one place where the editor ends a piece of speech and jumps elsewhere. You see the last
~4 seconds of speech the viewer hears (before ‖) and, in brackets, what the speaker says next in the
raw broadcast, which the cut leaves out.

For each line decide:
- F = the piece ends on a finished thought: a complete sentence or answer the viewer can accept as an
  ending, even if more talk follows in the raw.
- U = the piece cuts the thought short: a hanging connective or particle (คือ, ก็, ว่า, แต่, แล้ว ...),
  a sentence or question left unfinished, a word cut in half, or the point not yet made.
Judge only the language. Reply with JSON only, one key per line id, value "F" or "U", nothing else.
